headline: MT Educare discloses quarterly payment defaults for September 2026
hook: Payment default disclosure from MT Educare
summary: MT Educare Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding its financial defaults on payments for the quarter ending September 2026. Such disclosures indicate ongoing liquidity stress within the financially troubled education company. Retail investors holding the stock face heightened risks of capital erosion and corporate governance concerns. The filing highlights persistent operational hurdles for the company.
whats_next: Further exchange disclosures on debt resolution or insolvency proceedings
why_it_matters: Persisting payment defaults signal high risk for remaining equity holders.

headline: MT Educare releases AGM scrutinizer report and voting outcomes
hook: MT Educare files AGM voting results
summary: MT Educare Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer's report following its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company also filed the formal voting results with the NSE. These documents confirm the shareholder approval status for resolutions proposed during the meeting.
why_it_matters: Confirms shareholder mandate on company resolutions.
